description: This PHP class 'OA_UpgradePostscript_2_7_11_dev' handles database updates for campaign revenue types during an upgrade process in Revive Adserver. It queries campaigns with null revenue types, determines the appropriate revenue type based on campaign metrics, and updates the database accordingly.

classes.name: OA_UpgradePostscript_2_7_11_dev
classes.description: A class responsible for updating campaign revenue types during a database upgrade in Revive Adserver.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the campaign revenue type update based on campaign metrics.

methods.name: logOnly
methods.description: Logs informational messages during the upgrade process.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs error messages during the upgrade process.
